notes.title: 🕹️ Coherent Update and Patch Notes 1.1 🛠️
notes.content:
[b]Dear Runners[/b]

I'm very excited to announce the first content update for the game: [b]Patch 1.1 [/b] ːsteamhappyː

Introducing a [b]new playable level[/b] called [b]Coherent [/b]where you must finish all levels in a single run. 
If you fail, you'll respawn at the start. Good luck! ːspyconː

[b][Content][/b]
[list]
[*] Added a new level named Coherent [L11], which includes all levels.
[*] Added the game version number to the Main Menu.
[/list]

[b][Fixes][/b]
[list]
[*] Improved the Restart function, making it much faster and more efficient.
[*] Added a collider near the lasers in Triggered Trails [L5].
[*] Fixed some audio in Descent [L7] to trigger correctly.
[*] Fixed the audio at the end of Ice Cave [L8], which wasn't triggering correctly.
[/list]

[b][Design][/b]
[list]
[*] Changed the ambient in City of Cold [L6].
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41978791/2a5deed05fdc089e810ff440f0c4c0296bdb0907.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41978791/b5ac29f30015e12f1d8b3ce11a7b4058b4c548c5.png[/img]

If you would like to talk and share opinions on the game, feel free to join [url=https://discord.gg/6kwMw89857]Discord[/url] ːsteamhappyː

Enjoy the update, and thank you for your support! ːfh4trophyː

- Atis the Developer

notes.title: 🕹️ Discord, Speedrun and Patch Notes 1.02 🛠️
notes.content:
[b]Dear Runners[/b]

Today, I'm excited to announce some updates with the second patch for the game: [b]Patch 1.02 [/b] ːsteamhappyː
The most exciting news is that starting today, the game's [url=https://discord.gg/6kwMw89857]Discord server[/url] is live!
If you want to chat with others or me in the community, please join! ːsteamthisː
_________________________________________________________

Also, if you're interested in competing in speedruns, I'm thrilled to announce that the game's profile has also been set up on [url=https://www.speedrun.com/RUNREND]Speedrun.com[/url]. 
Feel free to share your runs with the speedrunning community there as well.

[b][Fixes][/b]
[list]
[*] On the first level, Dreamfall [L1], changed the distance of some floating islands from the player
[*] Also added the text "HOLD" to the ladder introduction sign to better indicate how to use the ladders.
[*] On Unstable [L2], increased some platform's visibility by adding yellow LEDs to it.
[*] On New Heights [L3], slightly adjusted the offset of the Jumppad at the end to better indicate its state.
[*] Fixed an issue in Triggered Trails [L5] where players could die from inactive lasers.
[*] Fixed all laser shadows, since lasers don't really have shadows.
[/list]

[b][Design][/b]
[list]
[*] Double jump window extended from 0.05 to 0.08, providing players with more time to execute this move effectively.
[/list]

[b][Social][/b]
[list]
[*] Added [url=https://www.speedrun.com/RUNREND]Speedrun.com[/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/6kwMw89857]Discord [/url]links to the main menu
[/list]

Enjoy the updates, and thank you for your support! ːfh4trophyː

- Atis the Developer

notes.title: 🕹️ Full Release and Patch Notes 1.01 🛠️
notes.content:
Yaay ːsteamhappyː Finally, the game is released, and it's time for celebration!
I've watched a few walkthroughs, and all I can say is that you guys rock! ːspyconː

Today, I'm bringing you some fixes with the very first patch for the game: [b]Patch 1.01[/b]

[b][Fixes][/b]
[list]
[*] Resolved an issue where rapidly switching between different level leaderboards could cause a stacking bug.
[*] Fixed an issue in New Heights [L3] where players could die from inactive lasers.
[*] Added sounds to the breakable platforms at the start of Bound to Ice [L9].
[*] Fixed a bug in Pathway Lost [L10] where the player could walk through walls after the ladder jump.
[*] Fixed the Player starting view in Pathway Lost [L10].
[*] Fixed shadows at the start in Triggered Trails [L5].
[/list]
[b][Features][/b]
[list]
[*] Mouse buttons can now be bound to actions.
[/list]
Enjoy the updates, and thank you for your support! ːfh4trophyː

- Atis the Developer

notes.title: 🛠️ RUNR END Demo update and bug fixes
notes.content:
[b]Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] Mouse sensitivity now adjustable down to 0.1.
[*] New developer record time set: 0:21,92.
[/list]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Corrected wood holder and fence collision bug at the start of the level.
[*] [b]Double jump window extended[/b] from 0.0 to 0.05, providing players with more time to execute this move effectively.
[*] Fixed an issue where players could become stuck under one of the platforms, potentially leading to them falling out of the game world.
[*] Solved a problem where the Main Menu camera was not looping correctly, which led to it prematurely restarting the animation with a noticeable cut.
[/list]

[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] An exception has been made for the end trigger. Now, F keys, Shift, or Tab won't trigger the Main Menu. This allows you to open the Steam Overlay and take screenshots of your gameplay without triggering the Main Menu scene.
[/list]


- Atis the Developer

notes.title: 🕹️ RUNR END Demo now available!
notes.content:
Attention all aspiring platformers and adventure seekers! I am thrilled to announce the release of the game demo version of RUNR END! Get ready for an immersive experience in a dreamish world, where challenges await and each jump is crucial.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2489410

The demo features one exhilarating level for you to try out, and here's the exciting part: you can even compete against me, the developer, in terms of time. Can you beat my best time?

I sincerely hope you enjoy the game and I am eagerly looking forward to hearing your thoughts on it! Your feedback is invaluable to me as I strive to make the game even better.

Stay tuned, as the full release of [b]RUNR END[/b] will be [b]available soon[/b]. Get ready to embark on an challenging adventure!

- Atis the Developer
